structured_prompt:
SINGLE OBJECT PRODUCT SHOT
One white ceramic dinner plate, 20cm diameter, flat circular with raised rim and concave center. Matte B4C technical ceramic. 3D object clearly visible, not abstract pattern.

FORM DEFINITION
Single solid ceramic plate with distinct 3D form. Flat base, raised outer rim, circular edge profile. Object casts shadow on surface beneath. Physical object presence, not texture or pattern. Readable as manufactured tableware immediately.

3D STRUCTURE
Plate rim visible as continuous circular edge. Slight depth showing concave bowl area. Thickness visible at rim edge. Object sits on surface with natural shadow contact. Foreground to background depth visible.

MATERIAL
Matte B4C technical ceramic, warm porcelain-white. Subtle surface texture on 3D form. Zero gloss. Cold industrial ceramic. Non-plastic.

COMPOSITION
Single object centered. Full plate visible from rim edge to rim edge. 45-degree angle showing top surface and rim thickness. Clean separation from dark concrete background. No pattern fills, no decorative elements.

LIGHTING
Studio directional light from upper left. Clear shadow cast beneath plate. Rim highlight defining edge. Dark background minimal.

FORBIDDEN
No abstract patterns. No mosaic. No stained glass effect. No wall texture. No surface-only composition. Must be clear 3D object.

COLOR
subtractive mineral color logic
color must follow form then material, never override them
low saturation, no neon
matte-first material response
shadow-dominant composition (70%)
bokashi gradient, non-linear
no flat color, always material texture variation
diffuse highlights, not specular
pure white and pure black are forbidden
plastic-clean RGB color is forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones
shadow_anchor_sumi_iro
highlight_anchor_gofun
crimson_seam_if_applicable

Ensure the object is clearly defined and centered, with strict chiaroscuro lighting and a minimal, dark concrete background. Absolutely no abstract elements, glossy finishes, or loss of object identity.
